scenario_description: Elena is assigned to Indianola K-8 School on June 15, and she has a vehicle-service appointment later that afternoon near Dominion Middle School. Both commitments are workable, but traveling from Indianola to the service shop would add a substantial cross-town drive. A fellow substitute later reveals that she is assigned to Dominion that day but would prefer Indianola because of a nearby family pickup. The opportunity becomes sufficiently observable at event3: exchanging school assignments would align both substitutes with their afternoon destinations and reduce unnecessary driving, but Elena must connect the separate schedules and coordinate approval. Events 4 and 5 confirm that the exchange is permitted and that the coworker agrees, while event6 adds a response deadline. Ignoring the opportunity would not disrupt either assignment or appointment; Elena would simply keep her original route.

parameter.subject: June 15 substitute assignment confirmed at Indianola
parameter.body: Your substitute assignment is confirmed for Monday, June 15, 2026, at Indianola K-8 School, 420 E 19th Avenue. Please report by 7:20 AM. The assignment ends at 3:30 PM, and no travel to another school is required.

parameter.subject: Vehicle inspection appointment confirmed for June 15
parameter.body: Your optional vehicle inspection is confirmed for Monday, June 15, at 4:30 PM at North High Auto, 4675 N High Street, Columbus. The shop is about five minutes from Dominion Middle School. Your current 4:30 PM time leaves enough time to arrive from Indianola after work, although that trip typically takes 30 to 40 minutes in afternoon traffic.

parameter.subject: My June 15 assignment is at Dominion
parameter.body: I am assigned to Dominion Middle School from 7:20 AM to 3:30 PM on June 15. I need to pick up my daughter near Indianola shortly after work, so Indianola would be much more convenient for me that day. I heard you may be working there. I do not know whether substitutes can exchange confirmed locations, but I would be interested if that is allowed.

parameter.subject: June 15 substitute location exchanges are permitted
parameter.body: Confirmed substitutes may exchange June 15 school locations when both assignments cover the same hours and both substitutes agree. Indianola and Dominion each need one substitute from 7:20 AM to 3:30 PM that day, so an exchange between those assignments can be approved without affecting coverage. Send me one email copying both substitutes and stating who will report to each school.

parameter.subject: I agree to exchange June 15 school locations
parameter.body: I am willing to report to Indianola K-8 School on June 15 if you would like to take my Dominion Middle School assignment. I can confirm the exchange to Luis as soon as you decide.

parameter.subject: Deadline for June 15 location exchange
parameter.body: Please send any agreed Indianola-Dominion exchange by noon on Friday, June 12, so I can update both school rosters. If I do not receive joint confirmation, your current assignments will remain unchanged.
